name: Espino de la Orbada (Spain)
description: Square flag divided per saltire, white above and below and red at the hoist and the fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Espino de la Orbada (a thorn bush and a jug on green, a bridge and waves).
history: The arms of Espino de la Orbada were published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 7 April 2015 and the flag was approved on 7 April 2016; the flag is quartered per saltire, gules and argent, charged with the arms.

features.role: division per saltire, white above and below
